page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: running head at top, page number 338 at top centre, then one main text block with a brace-diagram at the top and marginal-free text; no notes in the left margin. Right page: a narrow column of cut-off text at the right edge (margin fragments of the neighbouring page), which is not transcribed beyond the visible words. Order: all of the left page, then the right page fragment.

main_text.p: In coniugio prohibebatur mulier meritrix, profana, repulsa a viro. Leu.21.7.
Cuius æquitas perpetua est, vt miniftrorum vxores σεμνοι sint, & in moribus, & educatione sua ab omni opprobrio immunes. 1.Tim.4.11.
In alimento, vinum & Shecar, siue potus inebriens cum vxoris consortio: quæ ipsis ad tempus quo intrabant in Tabernaculum prohibebantur. Leu. 10.8.
Æquitas autem perpetua est, vt hæc (præcipue in ministerij executione) parce & ad infirmitates naturales sublevandas sufcipiant. 1.Tim.5.23.
In luctu autem vt tantum super matre, patre, filio, filia, fratre & sorore sua virgine se in luctu contaminarent. Leu.21.1.2.3.
main_text.head: Atq; hæc de sacerdotibus.
main_text.p: Summus sacerdos erat semper successionis vicissitudine unicus, reliquorum præcipuus, qui in sancto sanctorum cultum & obseruationem exercebat. Præcipue Christi figuram in sui muneris partibus gerebat. Heb.9.6.7.
Huius con- {brace} consecratio specialis. Leu.21. sideranda {brace} abstinentia specialis. 10.12.

page.notes: Right page shows only fragmentary cut-off marginal words (Spec, crat, bet, orta, natu, comm, Sunt, inferi, 38.39, Erant, Tu, Ba, Pr, lebant, Sunt a, Reliqu, veftes, Exod.2) which are partly visible at the edge; not transcribed. Brace diagrams are rendered as plain lines; their exact box structure is uncertain.
